data.longBusinessSummary: Entrepreneur Universe Bright Group, through its subsidiaries, provides digital marketing and consulting services in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. It also offers marketing consulting and sourcing services. The company was formerly known as REE International, Inc. and changed its name to Entrepreneur Universe Bright Group in April 2020. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China. Entrepreneur Universe Bright Group is a subsidiary of Tethys Fountain Limited.
